CustomField.description: Junior's 8 deal-tracker buckets, derived from stage + deal category. Reporting-only projection - automation must branch on StageName/Deal_Category__c, never on this formula (before-save flows cannot read formula fields).
CustomField.formula: IF(OR(ISPICKVAL(Deal_Category__c,'Dead'), ISPICKVAL(StageName,'Dead/Pass')), 'Dead', IF(ISPICKVAL(StageName,'Closed Won'), 'Bought/Closed', IF(OR(ISPICKVAL(StageName,'PSA Executed'), AND(ISPICKVAL(StageName,'Under Contract'), Contract_Signed__c)), 'PSA Executed/About to Close', IF(OR(ISPICKVAL(StageName,'PSA Negotiation'), ISPICKVAL(StageName,'Under Contract')), 'PSA Negotiation', IF(ISPICKVAL(StageName,'LOI Signed'), 'LOI Accepted', IF(ISPICKVAL(StageName,'LOI Submitted'), 'LOI Submitted', IF(OR(ISPICKVAL(StageName,'Initiate LOI'), ISPICKVAL(StageName,'LOI Under Approval')), 'LOI Pending', 'Interested Deals')))))))
CustomField.label: Deal Tracker Bucket
